svg.title: ORB | Exact opening-range geometry did not pass its control test
svg.desc: USTEC2 posthoc Discovery mechanism study: frozen 18-cell LONG region, Jan 2020–Nov 2024 signals; December burnoff; 2020 partial. Same-width alternative range boundaries. Both comparisons required positive median differences and ≥12/18 favourable cells. Specificity failed. Each dot is a correlated configuration-level paired difference, not a trade pair or independent replication. Dashed gold = median; no invented intervals.
